$comment: The 1.0 coverage floors from docs/roadmap/v1/QUALITY.md, enforced per package (spec 089). Never lower these to pass: add tests, or bring structural evidence to the maintainer. TypeScript coverage does not measure Angular templates — those stay certified by the rendered/browser suites.

environments.db: node (vitest) incl. on-disk libSQL + adapter contracts
environments.s3: node (vitest) against a faked S3 client; the real-service suite is certification, not coverage
environments.cloudflare: node (vitest) src suites; the workerd D1/R2 suite (test/workers) cannot report v8 coverage and is NOT counted — the number is a lower bound
environments.testing: attributed from the contract suites that db/auth/storage/runtime/cloudflare run (source-aliased)
environments.angular: node + jsdom (vitest); templates are not measured by TS coverage
environments.admin: jsdom + Angular TestBed (vitest, Angular compile transform); templates are not measured by TS coverage
